main_measure.name: mean of (10-day return minus coin drift) x forecast/10 on grid cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: above 0 with t >= 2 (and check passes); reject: below 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: deeper-half minus shallower-half mean 10-day return minus drift (Welch t <= -1)

decided_by: the main measure is above 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting check passes (confirm rule)
reading: Cases are grid bars (0, 10, 20, ... of each window, with 10 bars ahead inside it) whose recorded regime is mean_reversion, whose close is above the prior close and whose forecast is below 0; the coin's drift is the mean 10-day return over all grid bars of all its windows; the deeper half is |forecast| strictly above the median, the rest the shallower half; the plan's 'fewer than 30 distinct case days' is applied as the minimum count giving 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: too few cases on the check folds (86 cases, 86 days)
